The three steps (v34.24 panels, v34.25 type scale, v34.26 corners) are in the build and all four critic scores are written. The 21-raid-hud-calm screen stopped at 3, short of the target of 4, so the task is finished only under its second condition.

| Screen | Critic before | Critic after |
|---|---|---|
| 21 raid hud calm | 2 | 3 |
| 19 first raid | 2 | 3 |
| 37 extracting | 3 | 3 |
| 61 wheel open | 3 | 3 |

- **Best two versions:** v34.23 (pictures in `notes/shots/102-before`) and v34.26 (`notes/shots/102-final`). Keep v34.26.
- **What moved:** every HUD panel is one graphite fill, distinct on-screen word sizes in a raid frame went from 14 to 10, and the gun card footer and board title are quieter.
- **Frame cost:** I added no draw calls, only font, colour and zoom values. I could not read `DRS.workMs` from the headless gate, so it was not measured.
- **Watch line for his next playtest:** the vitals and belt sit a hair smaller and left, the pillager board is a little narrower, and the ammo card footer is quieter.
- **Why screen 21 is stuck:** every remaining critic finding is layout or one of his rulings, not type or colour. No further type or colour step would raise it. The remaining findings, all logged in `notes/102-ui-raid-hud-calm.md`:
  - The key legend (about 400x170) is open on raids 1 to 3. It needs the legend job, and his Q70 rules out tutorial prompts.
  - The contract lines wrap.
  - The hotbar shows two slots as selected.
  - Extraction shows twice.
  - The extract timer is 30 px against the 56 px the critic wants, and a second hero would compete with ammo.
  - The toasts differ in width and bar colour.

TASK DONE
